# Themes

Every colour, size, radius and space in the stylesheet is a custom property from `tokens.css`. Change a token and everything that uses it follows.

Name a theme on `<html>`, or on any element to theme only what is inside it: `<html lang="en" data-theme="mint">`.

- `light`: Light, light
- `dark`: Dark, dark
- `linen`: Linen, light
- `mint`: Mint, light
- `sky`: Sky, light
- `rose`: Rose, light
- `lilac`: Lilac, light
- `midnight`: Midnight, dark
- `forest`: Forest, dark
- `espresso`: Espresso, dark

The page on the site has a maker: four colours in (the page, the tray, the ink and the accent), a whole theme out, checked for contrast.
